newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER-ENGLISH AND SCOTTISH LEAGUE FIXTURES - OCTOBER 18-20.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-ENGLISH AND SCOTTISH LEAGUE FIXTURES - OCTOBER 18-20.

text.p: English and Scottish league soccer
fixtures for October 18 to 20:
Friday, October 18:
English division one - Oxford v Birmingham.
Saturday, October 19:
English premier league - Arsenal v Coventry, Aston Villa v
Leeds, Chelsea v Wimbledon, Middlesbrough v Tottenham,
Nottingham Forest v Derby, Sheffield Wednesday v Blackburn,
Southampton v Sunderland, West Ham v Leicester.
English division one - Bradford v Barnsley, Charlton v
Bolton, Crystal Palace v Swindon, Grimsby v West Bromwich,
Huddersfield v Southend, Ipswich v Portsmouth, Manchester United
v Norwich, Oldham v Reading, Stoke v Sheffield United,
Wolverhampton v Port Vale.
English division two - Brentford v Walsall, Bristol Rovers v
Blackpool, Burnley v Notts County, Bury v Watford, Chesterfield
v Crewe, Gillingham v Millwall, Luton v Peterborough, Plymouth v
Bristol City, Preston v Shrewsbury, Wrexham v Bournemouth,
Wycombe v Stockport, York v Rotherham.
English division three - Barnet v Hartlepool, Cambridge v
Rochdale, Carlisle v Cardiff, Chester v Exeter, Darlington v
Mansfield, Doncaster v Brighton, Hereford v Leyton Orient, Hull
v Fulham, Lincoln v Scarbroough, Northampton v Colchester,
Swansea v Scunthorpe, Wigan v Torquay.
Scottish premier division - Dunfermline v Dundee United,
Kilmarnock v Raith, Motherwell v Hibernian, Rangers v Aberdeen.
Scottish division one - Airdrieonians v Stirling, Clydebank
v Greenock Morton, Dundee v Partick, Falkirk v St Johnstone, St
Mirren v East Fife.
Scottish division two - Berwick v Clyde, Brechin v
Stenhousemuir, Hamilton v Ayr, Queen of the South v Livingston,
Stranraer v Dumbarton.
Scottish division three - Alloa v Montrose, Cowdenbeath v
Inverness, East Stirling v Queen's Park, Forfar v Albion, Ross
County v Arbroath.
Sunday, October 20:
English premier league - Liverpool v Everton, Newcastle v
Manchester United.
English division one - Tranmere v Queens Park Rangers.
Scottish premier division - Hearts v Celtic.
